firewall {
    ipv4 {
        name FINANCE-TO-MGMT {
            default-action drop
            description finance-to-mgmt
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
        }
        name FINANCE-TO-UPLINK {
            default-action drop
            description finance-to-uplink
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description finance-tls-out
                destination {
                    port 443
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description finance-app-out
                destination {
                    port 5201
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description finance-ping-out
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
        name GUEST-TO-MGMT {
            default-action drop
            description guest-to-mgmt
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
        }
        name GUEST-TO-UPLINK {
            default-action drop
            description guest-to-uplink
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description guest-http-out
                destination {
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description guest-tls-out
                destination {
                    port 443
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description guest-ping-out
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
        name MGMT-TO-FINANCE {
            default-action drop
            description mgmt-to-finance
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description admin-to-finance
            }
        }
        name MGMT-TO-GUEST {
            default-action drop
            description mgmt-to-guest
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description admin-to-guest
            }
        }
        name MGMT-TO-UPLINK {
            default-action drop
            description mgmt-to-uplink
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description admin-egress
            }
        }
        name MGMT-TO-USERS {
            default-action drop
            description mgmt-to-users
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description admin-to-users
            }
        }
        name UPLINK-TO-FINANCE {
            default-action drop
            description uplink-to-finance
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description uplink-ping-finance
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
        name UPLINK-TO-GUEST {
            default-action drop
            description uplink-to-guest
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description uplink-ping-guest
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
        name UPLINK-TO-MGMT {
            default-action drop
            description uplink-to-mgmt
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
        }
        name UPLINK-TO-USERS {
            default-action drop
            description uplink-to-users
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description uplink-ping-users
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
        name USERS-TO-MGMT {
            default-action drop
            description users-to-mgmt
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
        }
        name USERS-TO-UPLINK {
            default-action drop
            description users-to-uplink
            rule 10 {
                action accept
                description return-traffic
                state established
                state related
            }
            rule 20 {
                action accept
                description users-http-out
                destination {
                    port 80
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 30 {
                action accept
                description users-tls-out
                destination {
                    port 443
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 40 {
                action accept
                description users-app-out
                destination {
                    port 5201
                }
                protocol tcp
            }
            rule 50 {
                action accept
                description users-ping-out
                icmp {
                    type-name echo-request
                }
                protocol icmp
            }
        }
    }
    zone FINANCE {
        description finance-zone
        from MGMT {
            firewall {
                name MGMT-TO-FINANCE
            }
        }
        from UPLINK {
            firewall {
                name UPLINK-TO-FINANCE
            }
        }
        interface eth1.30
    }
    zone GUEST {
        description guest-zone
        from MGMT {
            firewall {
                name MGMT-TO-GUEST
            }
        }
        from UPLINK {
            firewall {
                name UPLINK-TO-GUEST
            }
        }
        interface eth1.20
    }
    zone MGMT {
        description mgmt-zone
        from FINANCE {
            firewall {
                name FINANCE-TO-MGMT
            }
        }
        from GUEST {
            firewall {
                name GUEST-TO-MGMT
            }
        }
        from UPLINK {
            firewall {
                name UPLINK-TO-MGMT
            }
        }
        from USERS {
            firewall {
                name USERS-TO-MGMT
            }
        }
        interface eth1.99
    }
    zone UPLINK {
        description uplink-zone
        from FINANCE {
            firewall {
                name FINANCE-TO-UPLINK
            }
        }
        from GUEST {
            firewall {
                name GUEST-TO-UPLINK
            }
        }
        from MGMT {
            firewall {
                name MGMT-TO-UPLINK
            }
        }
        from USERS {
            firewall {
                name USERS-TO-UPLINK
            }
        }
        interface eth2
    }
    zone USERS {
        description users-zone
        from MGMT {
            firewall {
                name MGMT-TO-USERS
            }
        }
        from UPLINK {
            firewall {
                name UPLINK-TO-USERS
            }
        }
        interface eth1.10
    }
}
interfaces {
    ethernet eth1 {
        vif 10 {
            address 10.10.10.1/24
            description users-gateway
        }
        vif 20 {
            address 10.10.20.1/24
            description guest-gateway
        }
        vif 30 {
            address 10.10.30.1/24
            description finance-gateway
        }
        vif 99 {
            address 10.10.99.1/24
            description mgmt-gateway
        }
    }
    ethernet eth2 {
        address 10.255.1.1/30
        description transit-to-fw-ext
    }
    loopback lo {
    }
}
pki {
    ca clab {
        certificate 
    }
    certificate self {
        certificate 
        private {
            key 
        }
    }
}
protocols {
    static {
        route 10.10.40.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.2 {
            }
        }
        route 10.10.50.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.2 {
            }
        }
        route 203.0.113.0/24 {
            next-hop 10.255.1.2 {
            }
        }
    }
}
service {
    https {
        api {
            keys {
                id admin {
                    key admin
                }
            }
        }
        certificates {
            ca-certificate clab
            certificate self
        }
        listen-address 0.0.0.0
    }
    ntp {
        allow-client {
            address 127.0.0.0/8
            address 169.254.0.0/16
            address 10.0.0.0/8
            address 172.16.0.0/12
            address 192.168.0.0/16
            address ::1/128
            address fe80::/10
            address fc00::/7
        }
        server time1.vyos.net {
        }
        server time2.vyos.net {
        }
        server time3.vyos.net {
        }
    }
    ssh {
        listen-address 0.0.0.0
    }
}
system {
    config-management {
        commit-revisions 100
    }
    console {
        device ttyS0 {
            speed 115200
        }
    }
    host-name fw-int
    login {
        user admin {
            authentication {
                encrypted-password $6$rounds=656000$nZkRRAF6U4Vs4kNY$wu6fOZ9bfevdNbb9QS3Esh.6mNGiFlbuvtUtOjh36HuQjthQIIwkmIGK6qDRfZ5qh1vEH6NwtMgOq8ACeFHJZ1
                public-keys clab {
                    key AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIHu16EcSD/NkpiCCnr86BbXxj7cg+bi+PyrPFQiEFB47
                    type ssh-ed25519
                }
            }
        }
    }
    syslog {
        global {
            facility all {
                level info
            }
            facility local7 {
                level debug
            }
        }
    }
}
